propositions: Every verification index in Pass-2 is rejected as unexpected when findings list is empty, degrading all findings to INDETERMINATE while leaving VERDICT unchanged
verify_instructions() returns an instruction to emit verifications but provides no indices when the batch is empty, causing the model to return indices 0..N-1 against an empty valid index domain
INDETERMINATE findings cannot block decision outcomes; they are silently absorbed or flip PASS to INDETERMINATE only when no advisory surfaces
The fix replaces the defective instruction string with EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, matching the contract prerequisite already established for empty cases
No real findings were lost in 43 affected runs; all were zero-finding runs with correct PASS verdicts that incurred spurious contract violation logs
